explanation: Its last emperor, Puyi, abdicated in 1912 at the age of six. Decades later, under communist rule, he worked as a gardener in Beijing.

claims.text: The Xinhai Revolution of 1911 ended the Qing dynasty.
The Ming, Song and Yuan dynasties had ended centuries before 1911.
Puyi, the last Qing emperor, abdicated in 1912 at the age of six.
Puyi later worked as a gardener in Beijing.
